summary: Full-extraction review of 20 stored Portuguese documents: two fee portarias (305-A/2012, 307/2023) and 18 SEF ARI statistical maps (2012-2013, 2014-2022 annual, cumulative to 2019 and to Sep 2023, monthly Jan-Jun 2023). The maps were already fully extracted except the 2012 total-investment box (1 row added); every existing value was re-read against the text layer and two OCR passes and every route breakdown checked against its printed totals. The portarias gained 8 fee terms (card copies, replacements, permanent residence for ARI holders) and one event for the 2023 fee table.

events.title: New fee table: EUR 7,730.11 per ARI permit
events.description: Portaria 307/2023 replaces Portaria 1334-E/2010 when AIMA takes over from SEF: EUR 773.74 analysis fee, EUR 7,730.11 to grant an investor or family permit, EUR 3,865.79 per renewal, EUR 10,822.14 for an ARI holder's permanent residence permit; grant and renewal revenue split equally between AIMA and the Foreign Ministry's FRI. Fees are indexed to inflation each 1 March; a 25% reduction applies to applications filed digitally (and, until services go digital, to in-person fees) and 10% to assisted in-person filing.
events.location: PDF p. 3 (Pág. 3), art. 6; p. 6 (Pág. 6), Anexo III.3-4; p. 8, Anexo XIV
events.quote: A presente portaria entra em vigor em 29 de outubro de 2023.

gaps: SEF maps print only the top five nationalities per period; no full nationality table, applications, rejections or fee revenue is in these documents.

ledger.contains: Portaria 305-A/2012 amending the immigration fee table (Portaria 1334-E/2010) to add fees for investment residence permits (ARI), in force 8 Oct 2012: EUR 500 analysis fee, EUR 5,000 issue fee for investor and for each reunited family member, EUR 2,500 renewal (investor and family), second/third copy and replacement fees as percentages of the analysis fee, revenue from issue and renewal fees split equally between SEF and FRI. Also EU Blue Card, Schengen-visa extension and long-term-resident fees (out of scope).

Portaria 307/2023, the full immigration fee table in force 29 Oct 2023 (AIMA replacing SEF): ARI analysis fee EUR 773.74, grant EUR 7,730.11 (investor and family), renewal EUR 3,865.79, second copy EUR 3,865.79, third copy EUR 7,730.11, replacement EUR 1,932.53, permanent residence for ARI holders EUR 10,822.14 (grant) and EUR 5,411.90 (renewal); revenue split AIMA/FRI; annual inflation indexation; 25%/10% reductions for digital/assisted filing. Also fees for border visas, stay extensions, ordinary and Blue Card permits, long-term residents, travel documents, and EUR 1,500,000 a year AIMA pays IRN for renewal intake (all out of scope: not about the ARI programme).
